title: Renee W NDE 22306
content: Sunday afternoon on a beautiful sunny day in Georgia, my family and friends were at a local lake. I was five years old and I was playing at the edge of the water. I saw some of my family out further in the water so I joined them. When I got to them, they instructed me to go back to the shallow water. I started to go back to the edge, and all of a sudden, I was in very deep water. I was looking up and I saw a boat motor about five or six feet over my head, then I was pulled up from the back and I could see a little girl at the bottom of the water. Her hair was gently waving in the water and the little girl was in trouble and I felt very concerned, but did not realize that the tiny child was me. I was pulled backwards out of the water, but I did not feel cold or wet. I felt like I was one with the world. Just energy or air. I could see the boat, and the water getting smaller and smaller. I was amazed because I had never seen things from the sky looking down before. I felt so light and had such a wonderful sense of union and belonging. As I started to turn toward away from the lake and to see where I was being pulled. I was choking and vomiting water. I felt heavy and sick, and I looked up and saw my uncle in a suit dripping from the water

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident I was swimming with my family and friends, I went in too deep and I drown Clinical death I would have died had my uncle not rescued me.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I could not see what image I took, but I do know that my body was at the bottom of the lake.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was conscious, however I did not recognized myself as the little girl.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I did not move as before. I had no arms or legs. It was like I was energy or wind. I don't remember smell or touch; I remember sight and a different feeling, like knowing without being told. Like being one with the universe.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Awe and sadness for the drowning child.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I was very young. It felt like I just knew things that I had never been told.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will Absolutely not I was out of my body. Then I was in it vomiting water.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will Absolutely not I was out of my body. Then I was in it vomiting water. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I felt I was alone in my knowledge because no one ever talked about the drowning.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I felt I was alone in my knowledge because no one ever talked about the drowning. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I did not have the vocabulary to express the experience as a child. I wanted to say I was energy. One with the universe. I will never forget the feeling. A wonderful gift to know there is more to come.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I have insight that other people don't seem to have. I know some things that seem obvious to me that are not obvious to other people. If I try to explain how I know they still don't see it.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The feeling I had 'in the air', was the best part. Returning to my body I could feel the pain of the burning in my lungs and nose as the water was coming out.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I have shared it, but I do not have any idea if anyone was influenced. I have had different reactions. Some very positive and some very negative, but mostly just interested in the bizarre.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Uncertain I have had a dream that was a lot like it but did not take meds or substances. It was a dream where I was pulled into an area and I was supposed to help open a door for this black man with large girth. I could not decide whether to help him or not. And I awoke before I could finish assisting him. The dream has never come back.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Just that it was the greatest gift I have ever been given. To know never have to wonder if there is life after death. It never crosses my mind, because I absolutely know that there is more, and that is more than enough for me.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: I think if you broke the senses down to ask a question about each of them it would help. Thank you.
